name: Famine
summary: IPC alert warns of growing famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan; no current Phase 5 classification
state: An IPC alert on 12 Oct warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan in Sudan (WHO). FEWS NET continues to track a credible risk of famine in parts of Sudan, and El Niño drought threatens East and southern Africa. No current IPC Phase 5 classification had been confirmed as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Mainly affects people in Sudan and neighbouring countries. Prices of staple imports in the region tend to rise as needs grow.
rubric_hit: Watch: IPC risk-of-famine alert for Darfur and Kordofan; no confirmed Phase 5

sources.title: WHO — IPC Sudan food insecurity and malnutrition alert

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
